nodes.title: PROMPT + REFERENCES (Ref2VA)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult woman whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>. Preserve her face, curvy body proportions, pink hair, red clown nose, rainbow choker, pink-and-white winged costume with button detailing, pink gloves, rainbow cuffs, and visible accessories.
<Picture 2> is the background only. It contains no subject. It supplies the colorful paneled backdrop for the scene, including its colors and lighting. Reproduce it as shown, with no added people or objects.

summary:
[reference generation] <Subject 1> stands in front of the backdrop from <Picture 2>, waves at the camera, does a slow full spin in place, and finishes facing the camera with her hands on her hips over a 5-second clip. The camera is stationary.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain her face, hair, clown nose, costume, gloves, and curvy figure from <Picture 1> while she waves, spins, and poses.
<Picture 2> (background throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - follow <Picture 2> exactly for the backdrop, its colors, and its lighting.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action rendering with the same character appearance as the references, placed against the background from <Picture 2>. Soft, even studio lighting matches the backdrop. The camera is stationary for the entire clip: a locked-off, fixed medium-wide frame with no pan, tilt, zoom, or movement.

[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot frames <Subject 1> standing in the center of the frame, full body visible from head to knees, in front of the colorful paneled backdrop from <Picture 2>. She faces the camera with a bright, open smile, her arms relaxed at her sides and her pink hair resting on her shoulders. She raises her right gloved hand to shoulder height and waves at the camera three times, her rainbow cuff swinging slightly with each wave. She lowers her hand, shifts her weight onto her toes, and begins a slow spin to her left in place. Her winged costume fans outward as she turns, showing her side, then her back, then her other side, while her pink hair swings out and settles. She completes the full turn and comes back to face the camera, planting her feet shoulder-width apart. She places both gloved hands on her hips, tilts her head slightly to the right, and holds the pose with a wide smile, her red clown nose catching the light. She stays still in this pose until the end of the shot, centered in the frame in front of the backdrop.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet room tone, with the soft rustle of her costume as she turns and the light tap of her shoes on the floor.

non_diegetic_music:
Light, bouncy pop music plays throughout, with a steady beat, bright synths, and a quick tempo.

nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
HOW TO USE (H3 Motion Context 0.6.2)

Use the buttons on the CLOWN CHAIN node, not ComfyUI's Run:
• Run / Re-roll: make the current clip again (change the seed for a new take)
• Approve: keep this clip and make the next one
• Chain: keep approving automatically (segments = how many clips, 0 = until Stop)
• Reset: back to the start (Load 0 / Save 1)
• Clear latents: delete the saved clips in the folder

First clip: Load 0 / Save 1 (nothing is loaded, it starts fresh).
Then Load 1 / Save 2, and so on. The buttons step these for you.

Load, Save and Clown Chain must stay inside the "Context + Load/Save + Chain" group or the buttons do nothing.

Each clip is saved to output/h3_ref2va/ already trimmed, so you can drop them on a timeline back to back.

Length must be 17k+5 frames (192 = 8 s, 243 = 10 s, 362 = 15 s).
Set resolution and length on the PROMPT node (480x864 = 9:16 at 0.5 MP).

Refer to pictures in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>... in the order they plug into ref_image_0, ref_image_1...

widgets_values:
WHERE TO GET THE NODES IN THIS WORKFLOW

Clown nodes + Clown Chain (Clown Context Suite):
https://github.com/roycho87/clown_context_suite

Load / Save Latent - install ONE of these, not both (they use the same node names):
  H3 Motion Context: https://github.com/NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context
  H3 Motion Context MultiRef: https://github.com/seitanism/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context-MultiRef

H3 Prompt IDE:
https://github.com/ethanfel/ComfyUI-H3-Prompt-IDE

KJNodes (MiniMax low-VRAM / Sage attention nodes):
https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes

ControlNet Auxiliary Preprocessors (only for Clown Carryover's depth / pose options; canny works without it):
https://github.com/Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux

VideoHelperSuite (Video Combine):
https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts (Show Text):
https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts

Everything else is built into ComfyUI. Update ComfyUI if the MiniMax H3 nodes are missing.
